title: Oral Water Ingestion in Heart Transplant Patients
brief_summary: In this study the investigators propose to assess the hemodynamic response to the ingestion of 16 fl oz of water. The investigators will test the hypothesis that water ingestion will increase the systemic vascular resistance.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* s/p cardiac transplantation scheduled for clinical right heart catheterization
* age \> 18 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* significant tricuspid regurgitation
* inability to safely swallow 500 ml of water
* other major medical comorbidities such as advanced renal disease where water ingestion may be harmful to patient
